title: Retrospective Analysis of treatment data regarding efficiency, efficacy and safety of a non-rechargeable deep brain stimulation system in patients with movement disorders.
summary: Systems for deep brain stimulation (DBS) are permanent implants to treat movement disorders. Non-rechargeable neurostimulators have a battery life from 3-5 years with large inter individual differences. This study looks into safety and efficacy of the Abbott Infinity DBS System and tries to identify factors that influence individuals battery life.

interventions.name: Adult patients that received an Abbott Infinity deep brain stimulation system or neurostimulator for treatment of their movement disorder at Heidelberg University Hospital between 2016 and 2025.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Implantation of an Abbott Infinity DBS system or neurostimulator to treat a movement disorder between 2016 and 2025.
Exclusion criteria:
Implantation of other DBS systems or neurostimulators.
